h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Yamunanagar

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Yamunanagar

items.pText: Yamunanagar is one of India's main plywood and timber centres, so buyers here know wood well and often ask whether a playground can be made of it. Some of ours are. FunPlay Systems makes wooden play structures in our NexLev range, along with galvanised steel and roto-moulded equipment, at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,280 km away.

The city lies in northern Haryana near the Shivalik foothills, beside the Yamuna, with hot summers, a monsoon from July to September and cold, foggy winters. We supply schools, colonies, factory campuses and parks here, with equipment sent by road and installed by our team or a dealer in north India. Tell us whether you prefer wood, plastic or a mix, and we will suggest pieces on a layout drawing.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Wooden or steel and plastic play equipment

c: range look natural beside lawns and trees, and suit farmhouses, resorts and schools that want a softer look. Galvanised steel with roto-moulded plastic needs less routine care and comes in more than 15 colours.

Wood outdoors needs attention. Check it each year for cracks and splinters, and keep the base dry so the foot of each post does not stay wet. Yamunanagar's mix of summer heat, monsoon rain and winter damp is hard on any timber, so follow the maintenance steps we share at handover. We also offer composite products in some ranges. items.q: Is wooden playground equipment suitable for north India's weather?
items.a: Yes, with regular care. Check wooden parts every year for cracks and splinters, keep post bases dry and follow our maintenance instructions, since heat, rain and winter damp all affect timber.

items.q: Which needs less maintenance, wood or plastic?
items.a: Galvanised steel with roto-moulded plastic parts needs less routine care than wood. Wood gives a natural look that many resorts and farmhouses prefer.
Yes. We send the equipment by road from Vasai East, about 1,280 km away, and install through our own team or a dealer in north India.
